test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_dictionary_filter_negated.parquet', Parquet) SELECT if(number % 10 = 0, '', concat('phrase_', toString(intHash64(number) % 30000))) AS phrase FROM numbers(20000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 100000, output_format_parquet_write_bloom_filter = 0, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1, max_block_size = 100000, max_insert_block_size = 100000, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_filter_negated.parquet', Parquet) WHERE phrase != '' SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_parsing_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_filter_negated.parquet', Parquet) WHERE phrase NOT IN ('', 'phrase_1') SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_parsing_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
